scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply osaii --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply osaii --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:dry: wrangler d1 migrations apply osaii --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc || echo '[dry-run] wrangler not authenticated — skipping'
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1 | head -n 100; echo 'lint: tsc done'
scripts.format: prettier --check . 2>&1 || echo 'format: install prettier to auto-format (npm i -D prettier)'
scripts.cosaii:check: cargo check --workspace --manifest-path cosaii/Cargo.toml && npm run typecheck -w @osaii/cosaii-client
scripts.cosaii:build: cargo build --release --manifest-path cosaii/Cargo.toml && npm run build -w @osaii/cosaii-client
